items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: That's where Joe Oliver Harvey had his band.

ctx.x: Right. That was after hours. And like going down to 31st Street, they had the Schiller's Inn, which was another nice offside cabaret; where we worked was at Columbia Tavern off 35th -- on 31st and State underneath the

Columbia Hotel. Then you had a place down further -- Jack Johnson used to own (unintelligible) to them. Well, there was a cabaret and after hours joint. Now, that's down in that part of the section. Then on -- over going toward the lake there was the Royal Aurora Garden. That's where Joe Oliver Harvey had his band. And that was -- in that particular section -- then up State Street, going back to 35th Street, all the big places was there, like Entertainers, the Auto Cafe, Dreamland, Sunset, Entertainers…
Well, what about the theaters? Where were they?
